name: Natsukawa Yuria
source:
A lively and athletic girl, Yuria is a natural leader beloved by the student body.

She’s truly the ideal candidate!

Except that her policies are… unorthodox. Can her popularity outshine her questionable agenda, or will she fall short of her goals?
